teaser.en: A silky-leaved wild relative of the amaranths, and one of the Digo's most common leafy vegetables.
teaser.sw: Ndugu wa porini wa mchicha mwenye majani laini kama hariri, na mojawapo ya mboga za majani zinazotumika zaidi na Wadigo.

summary.en: *Demu* is a small, silky-haired herb of the amaranth family. Pakia names it among the most common and widely used Digo vegetables.
summary.sw: *Demu* ni mmea mdogo wa familia ya michicha wenye manyoya laini kama hariri. Pakia anautaja miongoni mwa mboga za Kidigo zinazojulikana na kutumika zaidi.

about.en: *Psilotrichum sericeum* is a herb of the amaranth family with opposite leaves covered in fine, silky hairs, which gives the species its name. Its small, papery, whitish to greenish flowers are packed into short spikes or heads. Digo identify it by its leaves.
about.sw: *Psilotrichum sericeum* ni mmea mdogo wa familia ya michicha, wenye majani yanayoota kwa jozi zinazotazamana na yaliyofunikwa kwa manyoya membamba laini kama hariri; ndiyo yaliyoipa spishi hii jina lake. Maua yake madogo, makavu kama karatasi, meupe hadi ya kijani, hujazana katika masuke mafupi au vichwa. Wadigo huutambua kwa majani yake.

where.en: It grows in tropical Africa and Asia, in bushland, field edges and disturbed ground.
where.sw: Hukua katika Afrika na Asia ya kitropiki, vichakani, pembezoni mwa mashamba na kwenye ardhi iliyovurugwa.

uses.en: Its leaves are cooked and eaten. Pakia lists *demu* with *futswe*, *mnavu* and *mrenda* as among the most common and widely used Digo vegetables. The species was once named *Psilotrichum edule*, 'the edible psilotrichum'.
uses.sw: Majani yake hupikwa na kuliwa. Pakia anaorodhesha *demu* pamoja na *futswe*, *mnavu* na *mrenda* miongoni mwa mboga za Kidigo zinazojulikana na kutumika zaidi. Spishi hii iliwahi kuitwa *Psilotrichum edule*, yaani 'psilotrichum inayolika'.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *demu* and lists it among the names that cannot be analysed. He notes, with some surprise, that this group includes some of the most widely known plants. In Mgombato *demu* is a different word, meaning a rag or cloth. No Swahili or English name has been recorded.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo *demu* na kuliorodhesha miongoni mwa majina yasiyoweza kuchambuliwa. Anaeleza, kwa mshangao kiasi, kwamba kundi hili lina baadhi ya mimea inayojulikana zaidi. Katika Mgombato, *demu* ni neno tofauti lenye maana ya tambara au kitambaa. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa.

reason.sw: Mchicha pori, wa familia ileile na nao huliwa
